## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation 1) Sector outcomes are mixed—Energy leadership vs soft Tech and Industrials—so breadth positive but uneven; Confirmation 2) Major-cap divergences (MSFT, INTC, JPM showing conflicting 1W vs 1M patterns) suppress a clear risk bias; Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 are 4/5 Energy).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: PSX (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +9.12%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +9.42% | 1M: +14.65%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate showing modest strength: Real Estate (1W: +1.81% | 1M: +0.08%) (10 stocks). Utilities also positive: Utilities (1W: +1.14% | 1M: +5.16%) (10 stocks).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Industrials lag: BA (1W: -8.11% | 1M: +3.11%) CORRECTION, DE (1W: -7.81% | 1M: +4.84%) CORRECTION. Materials and Consumer Discretionary weaker: DD (1W: -5.95% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND and TSLA (1W: -5.96% | 1M: +3.45%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: OXY (1W: +12.29% | 1M: -4.01%) RECOVERY, PSX (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +9.12%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +11.12% | 1M: -11.30%) RECOVERY, MPC (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +9.42% | 1M: +14.65%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Energy) — concentration risk for indices.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: DD (1W: -5.95% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -5.96% | 1M: +3.45%) CORRECTION, GE (1W: -6.67% | 1M: +11.03%) CORRECTION, LOW (1W: -7.19% | 1M: -3.93%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -7.62% | 1M: +25.48%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in select Industrials and discrete tech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Top 1W movers: OXY (1W: +12.29% | 1M: -4.01%) RECOVERY, PSX (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +9.12%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +11.12% | 1M: -11.30%) RECOVERY, MPC (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +9.42% | 1M: +14.65%) ABOVE TREND; downside momentum in INTC (1W: -15.61% | 1M: -3.66%) BELOW TREND. Major divergences (several large caps with 1W ≠ 1M) warrant caution — tactical, not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed-to-soft: Technology (1W: -0.49% | 1M: +2.62%) (24 stocks). Leaders: META (1W: +9.40% | 1M: +15.12%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +4.08% | 1M: +1.55%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +2.40%) ABOVE TREND; laggards: ORCL (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -34.41%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -15.61% | 1M: -3.66%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth is mixed and leadership narrow.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Cautious constructive: Financials (1W: +0.49% | 1M: +7.81%) (20 stocks). Key names: V (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +10.77%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +10.13%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -0.94% | 1M: +8.70%) CORRECTION — positive 1M backdrop but mixed 1W action; sector supportive but not unequivocal.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Defensive tone with news catalysts: Healthcare (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +5.74%) (17 stocks). UNH (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +8.08%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -1.52% | 1M: +4.00%) CORRECTION; PFE (1W: +3.20% | 1M: -4.38%) RECOVERY aligns with recent bullish FDA-related headlines.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Energy and selective Financials while reducing exposure to structurally weak names in Tech (ORCL, INTC) and select Industrials showing short-term exhaustions. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — be selective given narrow Energy concentration and large-cap divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: PSX (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +9.12%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +9.40% | 1M: +15.12%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -15.61% | 1M: -3.66%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -34.41%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -8.11% | 1M: +3.11%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +8.09% | 1M: +0.72%) — momentum and breadth within sector to monitor. BEARISH: Industrials (1W: -2.42% | 1M: +5.43%) and Materials (1W: -2.33% | 1M: +0.70%) — watch for follow-through on heavy 1W selling.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: +4.08% | 1M: +1.55%) ABOVE TREND — sustain weekly strength to confirm broader tech participation. PSX (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +9.12%) ABOVE TREND — hold recent breakout to keep Energy leadership intact. INTC (1W: -15.61% | 1M: -3.66%) BELOW TREND — failure to stabilize signals deeper near-term risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
PFE (+75): PFE (1W: +3.20% | 1M: -4.38%) RECOVERY — FDA expansion headlines; price action confirms short-term accumulation. VLO (+50): VLO (1W: +9.42% | 1M: +14.65%) ABOVE TREND — bullish operational/news flow confirmed by strong price momentum.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
DD (-60): DD (1W: -5.95% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND — PFAS-related litigation headlines coincide with price weakness. WBD (-75) flagged in news but lacking provided 1W/1M here; monitor for confirmation in price before adjusting exposure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.42% | 1M: +14.65%), PSX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +9.12%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.40% | 1M: +15.12%) showing strength. Key risk: narrow Energy-led leadership and major-cap divergences (MSFT RECOVERY; INTC BELOW TREND; JPM CORRECTION) — monitor PFE news-confirmation and large-cap breadth for regime tilt.
